IGN® and IGN Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of IGN Entertainment, Inc. Back To Top Street Fighter • Oct 28, 2026 WWE 2K26 x Street Fighter Elite Pack Trailer
 Here's a look at the Street Fighter Elite Pack Trailer for WWE 2K26, the latest addition to the hit wrestling action game developed by Visual Concepts. Players can get a look at the Street Fighter Elite Pack crossover with Bianca Belair as Cammy, Ultimate Warrior as Blanka, Rock Final Boss as M. Bison, Dominik Mysterio as Ken, and Rey Mysterio as Ryu. The Street Fighter Elite Pack is available now for WWE 2K26 on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
